title: 结点电压法：电压源接在参考结点上
statement: 图示电路中 U_s = 20 V，I_s = 2 A（向上注入结点 c），R_1 = 2 Ω，R_2 = 6 Ω，R_3 = 2 Ω，R_4 = 2 Ω。以底部为参考结点。
用**结点电压法**求 u_b、u_c，以及电压源 U_s 吸收的功率。

questions.ask: 本电路有 3 个独立结点 a、b、c，为什么只需要列 2 个结点方程？
choices: 结点 a 的电压已知 u_a = U_s，不必对 a 列方程
电压源支路的电导为零，可以去掉
结点 a 与 c 的方程总是相同的
电压源可以等效为开路
questions.explain: 电压源一端接参考结点，另一端结点的电压直接等于 U_s = 20 V，这个结点不再是未知量；而且电压源电流无法用结点电压表示，本来也不能对 a 用电导形式列 KCL。
U_s 输出的电流就是 R_1 的电流 (20 − 12)/2 = 4 A，从“+”端流出：P = −20 × 4 = −80 W（发出 80 W）。

hints: u_a = U_s 是已知量，只有 u_b、u_c 两个未知结点电压。
结点 c：电流源 I_s 注入 c，写在方程右边。
solution: **1. 已知结点：** U_s 接在 a 与参考结点之间，u_a = **20 V**。

en.title: Nodal analysis: a voltage source tied to the reference node
statement: In the circuit, U_s = 20 V, I_s = 2 A (upwards, into node c), R_1 = 2 Ω, R_2 = 6 Ω, R_3 = 2 Ω, R_4 = 2 Ω. The bottom node is the reference.
Use **nodal analysis** to find u_b, u_c and the power absorbed by the voltage source U_s.

questions.ask: The circuit has 3 independent nodes a, b and c. Why are only 2 node equations needed?
choices: The voltage of node a is known, u_a = U_s, so no equation is written for a
The voltage-source branch has zero conductance and can be removed
The equations of nodes a and c are always identical
A voltage source can be replaced by an open circuit
questions.explain: One end of the voltage source is the reference node, so the other node's voltage is simply U_s = 20 V and is no longer an unknown. Besides, the source current can't be expressed through node voltages, so a conductance-form KCL at a isn't possible anyway.
With u_a = 20 V the two equations are (1/2 + 1/6 + 1/2)u_b − 0.5u_c = 10 and −0.5u_b + u_c = 2, giving u_b = 12 V.
The source current equals the current in R_1, (20 − 12)/2 = 4 A, leaving the "+" terminal: P = −20 × 4 = −80 W (it delivers 80 W).

hints: u_a = U_s is known; only u_b and u_c are unknown.
Node b: (1/R_1 + 1/R_2 + 1/R_3)u_b − (1/R_1)u_a − (1/R_3)u_c = 0; move the u_a = 20 V term to the right-hand side.
Node c: the current source I_s injects into c, so it goes on the right-hand side.
solution: **1. Known node:** U_s sits between a and the reference, so u_a = **20 V**.
**5. Source power:** i_R1 = (20 − 12)/2 = 4 A leaves the "+" terminal of U_s, so P_Us = −20 × 4 = **−80 W** (delivers 80 W).
**Check:** the resistors absorb 2×4² + 12²/6 + 2×2² + 8²/2 = 32 + 24 + 8 + 32 = 96 W; U_s delivers 80 W and I_s delivers 8 × 2 = 16 W, 96 W in total.
